checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: static responsive company site in docs/ plus a company-voice profile rewrite

impact_assessment.why: AegeanWorks has no web presence beyond GitHub; the profile also speaks as one person while the brand now presents as a company.
impact_assessment.benefits: A fast zero-dependency Pages site that presents the studio and its 33 public projects, warm company copy, and no build step.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GitHub Pages serves docs/ from main; dependency: none, no external fonts or CDNs; concurrency: single agent; state: new docs/ tree and README tree update
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep all assets local, respect reduced motion, verify contrast, screenshot desktop and mobile, and rerun the four AIKit gates

[1/3] Plan: make the mobile menu and reveals fail open when app.js fails, and verify CLS with PerformanceObserver

impact_assessment.why: A missing or broken app.js would have left mobile users with a dead toggle and hidden content, even though the no-JS path worked.
impact_assessment.benefits: Navigation and content survive a script failure; CLS measured at 0 across 390, 768, 1200 and 1440.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CSS/JS coupling; dependency: none; concurrency: unrelated agents' background processes; state: nav visibility gated on .js
impact_assessment.mitigation: Test four script states, measure real CLS and reduced motion in Chromium, and keep Nu and the four gates green
